The present writ petition has been filed by the petitioners to prepare the award after including the name of the petitioners in compensation list in accordance with the Right of Patna High Court CWJC No.4944 of 2023 dt.19-09-2023 Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as petitioners' land situated at Mauza- Babhangama Tola Lalpatti Thana No.271 from Khata No.299 in different plots of District- Supaul, which has not been Kulanand Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21594345/
1 inserted in the said compensation list.
3.

entities.text: Kulanand Yadav vs The State Of Bihar

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have filed representation to the District Magistrate, Supaul for compensation of acquired land for the Railway line project vide their representation dated 26.12.2022 but till date no action has been taken on the said representation.
4. Counsel for the State submits that he has received instructions and as per the instructions the land in question is in the nature of Gair Mazurua Land.

5. In the light of submissions made by the parties it transpires to this Court that time to time the Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Government of Bihar has issued circulars, in which even Gair Mazurua Malik or Gair Mazurua khas land may be declared as Raiyati land according to the said policy.

entities.text: Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Government of Bihar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 6. In this view of the matter, it is necessary that the District Magistrate, Supaul before whom petitioners have filed representation, may take a decision by way of passed a reasoned and speaking order in this regard within 3 months form the date Patna High Court CWJC No.4944 of 2023 dt.19-09-2023 of production of this order by the petitioners before him.

7. Upon the finding in the light of the circular No.925(6) dated 11.11.2014 the District Magistrate,
Supaul shall pass a reasoned and speaking order upon fixing a date granting the petitioners to present themselves with relevant documents and after hearing both the parties if it has been found by the District Magistrate, Supaul that the petitioners land come within category of Raiyati land then the process of acquisition and payment shall be made within 8 months thereafter.

But in case it has been found that petitioners' land do not come within the category of Raiyati land then in that case the liberty given to the petitioner is to avail further remedy in accordance with law.
8. With the aforesaid direction, this writ petition is hereby disposed off.

(Dr. Anshuman, J.) Ashishsingh/-
